q1: SELECT FOLLOWEE AS FOLLOWER, COUNT(FOLLOWEE) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOWEE IN (SELECT FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
q2: SELECT FOLLOWEE FOLLOWER, COUNT(DISTINCT FOLLOWER) NUM FROM FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOWEE IN (SELECT DISTINCT FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW) AND FOLLOWEE <> FOLLOWER GROUP BY FOLLOWEE ORDER BY FOLLOWER
q1_prompt_sql: SELECT FOLLOWEE AS FOLLOWER, COUNT(FOLLOWEE) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOWEE IN (SELECT FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
q2_prompt_sql: SELECT FOLLOWEE FOLLOWER, COUNT(DISTINCT FOLLOWER) NUM FROM FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOWEE IN (SELECT DISTINCT FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW) AND FOLLOWEE <> FOLLOWER GROUP BY FOLLOWEE ORDER BY FOLLOWER
explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not equivalent because Q1 does not account for the distinctness of followers when counting, while Q2 does. Q1 groups by FOLLOWEE and counts all occurrences of it as a FOLLOWER, regardless of whether they are distinct or not. In contrast, Q2 groups by FOLLOWEE and counts distinct followers, excluding cases where FOLLOWEE is the same as FOLLOWER.
